scope: Actual ESP parser/formatter and PAGE on PC; no target build or hardware I/O.
checks: PASS parse20: exact count beyond JS safe integer, separate sample tick, valid ARM seq0
PASS i64 grammar and range: both endpoints accepted, overflow/duplicates/junk rejected
PASS whole TEL: flag/time/seq bounds, duplicate/missing/unknown fields and old14 rejected
PASS false measurement flags remain valid control telemetry
PASS ESP_ONLY JSON: encoder metadata is null before first valid STM TEL
PASS STM JSON: exact decimal strings and boolean metadata
PASS JSON flags false: transport connected and count snapshot preserved
PASS stale JSON: existing freshness policy and last count retained
PASS JSON capacity: all count/numeric/text bounds fit, short buffer rejected
PASS Connection registration sends HELLO only, never ARM/PING/CMD
PASS No ticket or no startup completion prevents ARM
PASS Manual ARM consumes one ticket and sends exact contract
PASS First zero CMD follows matching ARM result and CMD ticket
PASS No CMD before ARM ACK even if state arrives first
PASS Zero stream observes 80 ms target and needs fresh one-use tickets
PASS Repeating a ticket snapshot does not extend its original client deadline
PASS ARM stays available at the ticket cutoff but a click waits instead of sending
PASS Short TTL tickets wait for a new ticket to fulfil exactly one manual ARM click
PASS A delayed browser timer cannot allow a late ARM click to send
PASS Repeated decreasing TTL snapshots reserve the margin only once
PASS Zero CMD waits for a new ticket when the send cutoff meets its next interval
PASS Transit margin blocks a click that would reach a simulated peer after expiry
PASS IDLE button stays enabled through repeated ticket renewals without sending
PASS A stale control offer disables ARM instead of keeping an idle button live forever
PASS Repeated clicks cannot extend the bounded ARM preparation wait
PASS A fresh offer at the ARM wait deadline is refused even if its timer is delayed
PASS A control stream gap cancels preparation before a late fresh offer can revive it
PASS Blur and hidden events cancel an unsent ARM even after focus returns
PASS DISARM cancels an unsent ARM and leaves it cancelled after its own OK
PASS PING cannot compete with an unsent manual ARM preparation
PASS ARM preparation is cancelled by NONE, STOPPING, BLOCKED or a different active owner
PASS Fault or stale telemetry cancels an unsent ARM before the control snapshot catches up
PASS Disconnect, offline and boot changes cannot move a waiting ARM into a new session
PASS A rejected ARM sent after preparation is not retried on subsequent tickets
PASS ACTIVE keeps the ARM button disabled through changing CMD tickets
PASS DISARM is enabled during ARM wait and supersedes its pending result
PASS Blur sends one DISARM; returning focus never auto-arms
PASS Hidden tab stops; hidden/unfocused ARM is rejected locally
PASS Stale control stream closes socket even with otherwise live telemetry
PASS STOPPING and BLOCKED snapshots revoke local stream without auto-retry
PASS Server rejection of ARM stops intent and requests DISARM
PASS Failed control result prevents further zero commands
PASS Wrong boot/session results cannot complete ARM
PASS Wrong control id cannot complete pending CMD
PASS Malformed control state or a changed mode closes the connection
PASS Rejected malformed diagnostic request preserves last valid result
PASS PING diagnostic still follows request/notice/result flow
PASS DISARM can preempt a waiting diagnostic PING
PASS Disconnect/reconnect clears command intent and only sends HELLO
PASS Old socket events cannot change the new session
PASS ESP boot change closes and requires a new manual request
PASS Send exception cancels local intent and starts one reconnect
PASS Telemetry watchdog preserves last good values on timeout
PASS Malformed telemetry preserves last data and closes
PASS Idle never starts ARM/CMD automatically and no speed textbox exists
PASS encoder PAGE accepts actual native formatter outputs, including initial/stale/false flags
PASS encoder PAGE keeps counts beyond 2^53 as exact strings
PASS encoder PAGE accepts both signed int64 endpoints
PASS encoder PAGE rejects lossy numbers and malformed/out-of-range count strings
PASS encoder PAGE rejects invalid flags, sample ticks and ARM sequences
PASS encoder PAGE does not use false measurement flags as malformed transport data
PASS encoder PAGE renders actual count strings without changing commands
PASS encoder PAGE read-only observer preserves raw strings and the original stop path
